description: This file defines data models related to meal tracking in a diet planner application. It includes enumerations for meal types, classes representing meal items and meals, and functions for serialization, deserialization, and conversions between string and enum representations.

classes.name: MealItem
classes.description: Represents an individual food item within a meal, including attributes such as food name, weight in grams, calories per 100 grams, and total calories.

classes.name: Meal
classes.description: Represents a collection of meal items at a specific date and time, including total calories and meal type.

methods.name: mealTypeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string into the corresponding MealType enum value.

methods.name: mealTypeToString
methods.description: Converts a MealType enum value into its string representation.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Serializes a MealItem instance into a Map suitable for database storage or JSON encoding.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Deserializes a Map into a MealItem instance.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Serializes a Meal instance into a Map suitable for database storage or JSON encoding.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Deserializes a Map into a Meal instance.
